simple_types.name: Clock_Output
simple_types.code: type Clock_Output is (None, GPOUT0, GPOUT1, GPOUT2, GPOUT3);

simple_types.name: Drive_Strength
simple_types.code:
type Drive_Strength is
  (Drive_2mA,
   Drive_4mA,
   Drive_8mA,
   Drive_12mA);

enumeration_literals.name: Drive_2mA
enumeration_literals.description: Lowest RF output power (~2 mA, minimum harmonic spurs)

enumeration_literals.name: Slew_Slow
enumeration_literals.description: Slower edge transition (reduces high odd harmonics)

enumeration_literals.name: Slew_Fast
enumeration_literals.description: Fast edge transition (maximum fundamental RF power)

array_types.name: Byte_Array
array_types.code: type Byte_Array is array (Natural range <>) of Interfaces.Unsigned_8;

array_types.name: Clock_Output_Status
array_types.code: type Clock_Output_Status is array (Valid_Clock_Output) of Output_Status;

record_types.name: Clock_Config
